title.to: Extract reusable feedback, head-fitting and scripted steering components

description.from:
## Scope

Extract the reusable feedback, learned decision head, and human steering boundaries from Jev-Flywheel while keeping the new library small and readable.

## Definition of done

Plexus-compatible feedback vocabulary, trusted fitting, out-of-fold calibration, and versioned human-approved edits work with a fake provider-neutral model.
description.to: Completed component extraction: trusted feedback vocabulary, guarded numerical fitting, out-of-fold calibration, scripted validated steering and lineage. This historical epic is NOT completion of the live integrated flywheel. Live rubric/task/example optimization, connected refitting and reviewer observability are tracked under decision-flywheel-e1e92986-a121-410a-b8c2-fb467d6b3d88. Retain closed component stories; integration must reuse them, not create a second flywheel.
